questions.q:
10. In Class 8 of a school, the ratio of students playing cricket to those playing football is 27 : 13, while the ratio of those playing football to those playing hockey is 26 : 14. If the total number of students in Class 8 is 470, and each student plays exactly one game, find the percentage of students of the class playing cricket. [Give your answer correct to two decimal places.]

SSC CHSL 25/05/2022 Afternoon
questions.s:
10.(c)

Ratio of students playing cricket to those playing football = 27 : 13

Ratio of students playing football to those playing hockey = 26 : 14

On balancing the ratio,

Cricket : Football : Hockey = 54 : 26 : 14

Total students = 54 + 26 + 14 = 94 unit

According to the question,

94 unit = 470

54 unit = 270

Number of player who play cricket = 270

Required percentage = 270470×100 = 57.45%

questions.q: 6. In an election between two candidates, 10% of the voters did not cast their vote and 5% of the votes polled were found invalid. The successful candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 1,710 votes. The number of voters enrolled on the voters list was:
questions.s:
6.(d)
Total votes = 100%
⇒Total casted votes = 100 × 910 = 90%
⇒valid votes = 90 × 95100 = 85.5%
Successful candidate votes = 85.5 × 55100 = 47.025%
⇒Other candidate votes = 85.5 × 45100 = 38.475%
According to question,
⇒47.025% - 38.475% = 1710
⇒8.55% = 1710
⇒100% = 20000

questions.s:
10.(a) Total number of voters = 100x

No of votes casted = 80x

Valid votes = 80x  - 1000

According to the question,

70100 × (80x - 1000) = 30100 × (80x - 1000)+ 1200

⇒ 40100× (80x - 1000) = 1200

⇒ 80x - 1000 = 1200 × 10040

⇒ 80x = 3000 + 1000

⇒ 80x  = 4000

⇒ x = 50

Total number of voters = 100 × 50 = 5000 votes

questions_hin.q_hi: 4. एक छात्र के अंतिम ग्रेड (final grade) उसके अंतिम परीक्षा स्कोर (60% भारित) और अंतिम प्रोजेक्ट स्कोर (40% भारित) द्वारा निर्धारित (determined) किए जाते हैं। यदि छात्र अंतिम परीक्षा में 75 और प्रोजेक्ट में 90 अंक प्राप्त करता है, तो छात्र का अंतिम ग्रेड कितना है?

10. एक चुनाव में केवल दो उम्मीदवार खड़े थे। 20% मतदाताओं ने अपना वोट नहीं डाला और 1000 वोट अवैध घोषित कर दिए गए। विजेता ने कुल वैध वोटों का 70% प्राप्त करके अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी को 1200 वोटों से हराया। चुनाव में मतदाताओं की कुल संख्या कितनी थी?
questions_hin.s_hi:
10.(a) मतदाताओं की कुल संख्या = 100x

डाले गए वोटों की संख्या = 80x

वैध वोट = 80x - 1000

प्रश्न के अनुसार,

70100 × (80x - 1000) = 30100 × (80x - 1000)+ 1200

⇒ 40100× (80x  - 1000) = 1200

⇒ 80x - 1000 = 1200 × 10040

⇒ 80x = 3000 + 1000

⇒ 80x  = 4000

⇒ x = 50

मतदाताओं की कुल संख्या  = 100 × 50 = 5000 वोट
